info.name: DevMentor API — Complete Collection
info.description:
# DevMentor Backend API

**Credit-Based Mentorship & Code Review Marketplace Platform**

---

## 🚀 Quick Setup

1. Set the `baseUrl` collection variable to your environment:
   - **Local**: `http://localhost:5000/api/v1`
   - **Production**: `https://dev-mentor-server.vercel.app/api/v1`

2. Set the `token` variable after login:
   - Login → copy `token` from response → set `token` variable

3. Use `Bearer {{token}}` as the Authorization header on all protected routes.

---

## 👥 3 Roles
| Role | Email | Password |
|---|---|---|
| **Admin** | `admin@devmentor.com` | `Admin@123456` |
| **Mentor** | `mentor@devmentor.com` | `Mentor@123456` |
| **Student** | `student@devmentor.com` | `Student@123456` |

---

## 💰 Credit System
- **1 Credit = 4 BDT**
- QUICK Code Review = **10 Credits**
- DEEP Code Review = **50 Credits**

item.name: Update Code Snippet (Student, OPEN Status Only)

request.description: Update the code snippet or description while the request is still in OPEN status.
Mentors browse OPEN requests (and expired PREVIEW_LOCKED ones) with tier, language, and keyword filters.

item.name: Preview Lock Request — 10 Min Exclusive Lock (Mentor Only)

request.description: Mentor acquires a 10-minute exclusive lock. No other mentor can preview or claim during this window.

item.name: Claim Review Request — SLA Starts (Mentor Only)

request.description: Mentor officially claims the request. Delivery deadline is calculated: QUICK = +2hrs, DEEP = +24hrs.
Mentor delivers feedback. Status → DELIVERED. Includes inline comments, refactored code, video & PR links.
Student approves the DELIVERED review. 100% of escrowed credits are released to the mentor's wallet. Status → COMPLETED.

item.name: Cancel Review Request — Full Refund (Student Only)

request.description: Student cancels an unclaimed request. 100% of escrowed credits refunded. Status → CANCELLED.

item.name: 💳 Payments & Wallet
item.description: bKash Tokenized Checkout payment integration and credit wallet management.

request.description: Initiates a bKash payment session. Returns `bkashURL` to redirect user for payment. 500 BDT = 125 Credits.
bKash calls this URL after payment. Executes the payment, credits the user's wallet atomically, and emails a PDF receipt.

item.name: Get My Wallet Balance & Transaction Log

request.description: Returns wallet balance, totalEarned, totalWithdrawn, and full credit transaction history.
Returns all bKash payment records (top-ups and withdrawals) for the logged-in user.
Mentor requests a bKash cash-out. Minimum 1000 BDT. Deducts credits and logs a WITHDRAWAL transaction.
